vibe.verdict: A handsome gold banquet that gets the castle and the S-Mart joke right, but it plays the film polite and misses the boomstick and the sugar line.
missing: This is my boomstick (Ash in the pit)
Gimme some sugar, baby (Ash kisses Sheila)
Hail to the king, baby (S-Mart ending)
Three books in the graveyard and Ash mumbling Klaatu barada nikto
ideas: Swap 'Lord Arthur's castle roast chicken' note for 'Hardware, aisle twelve. Retails for about $109.95' to bring in the boomstick speech.
Swap 'Mulled ale with nutmeg' for 'Gimme some sugar mead cordial' to use the Sheila kiss line.
Swap the 'Place card' line 'Lord Arthur requests your presence' for 'Hail to the king, baby'.
Swap 'Ash's forgotten words honey cake' note for 'Klaatu, barada, nec... it's an N word' so the joke is the real line.
